verses.text: A psalm of David. LORD, I call to you. Come quickly to help me! Listen to me when I call to you.
May my prayer rise up to you like incense. May my lifted hands be like the evening sacrifice.
LORD, put a guard over my mouth. Keep watch over the door of my lips.
Do not let my heart be drawn to anything evil, to join evil people in doing wicked things. Do not let me eat their fine food.
If a good person strikes me, it is a kindness. If he corrects me, it is like oil on my head. I will not refuse it. But I keep praying against the evil things that wicked people do.
When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the wicked will hear my words and know they were true.
They will say, "As the ground is ploughed and broken up, our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave."
But my eyes are on you, LORD, my Lord. I come to you for safety. Do not leave me helpless.
Keep me from the traps they have set for me, from the traps of those who do evil.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets while I escape safely.
